name: defi_loop
summary: Pure stdlib orchestrator for the canonical Sui USDC leveraged-lending loop: deposit collateral → borrow against it at safety_ltv → re-deposit the borrowed amount → re-borrow → repeat until target leverage, max iters, or health drops. Composes the existing sui_mcp.lend_pool_deposit / lend_pool_borrow primitives — never reaches around them. Every step is crystal-anchored (tier='defi_loop', model='sui_lending', scope=f'loop_step_{i}_<action>'); a final 'loop_complete' record summarizes. DRY-RUN is the default; leveraged real-money loops above 2x require explicit confirm_above_2x=True; loops above 5x are rejected before any work.
engine_pattern: Deterministic integer-micro arithmetic. Iteration 0 = seed deposit of base_collateral. Each subsequent iteration i: compute borrow_amt = cumulative_collateral * safety_ltv (integer-micro), check projected debt/collateral <= safety_ltv (refuse otherwise → 'health_low'), execute borrow via sui_mcp.send('lend_pool_borrow', ...), then re-deposit borrow_amt via sui_mcp.send('lend_pool_deposit', ...). The borrowed amount IS the next deposit. Stop when current_leverage >= target_leverage ('target_reached'), iter cap hit ('max_iters'), or projected_ltv > safety_ltv ('health_low'). Final loop crystal = BLAKE3 over canonical JSON of [asdict(s) for s in steps].

api.main_function: run_loop(pool_id, base_collateral_micro, target_leverage=3.0, safety_ltv=0.65, max_iters=8, dry_run=True, confirm_above_2x=False) -> LoopResult

dataclasses.LoopStep: iteration, action ('deposit'|'borrow'), amount_micro, cumulative_collateral_micro, cumulative_borrow_micro, current_leverage, estimated_health_factor, crystal, tx_digest, dry_run, error
dataclasses.LoopResult: target_leverage, achieved_leverage, iterations_run, stop_reason, steps[List[LoopStep]], total_collateral_micro, total_borrow_micro, started_at, ended_at, crystal

hard_cap.rationale: Loops at >5x leverage make liquidation effectively a single bad-block event on Sui — no on-chain safety net we can build around it. Hard refuse, no override.

soft_cap.rule: target_leverage > 2.0 AND dry_run=False AND confirm_above_2x is not True → refuse before iteration 0
soft_cap.rationale: 2x is the canonical conservative ceiling for unattended leverage. Real-money loops above that demand an out-of-band human-in-the-loop confirm flag (NOT a CLI arg the caller might fat-finger).

dry_run_default.rule: dry_run=True is the API default and the CLI default. Every LoopStep records dry_run=True. No on-chain side-effects without the caller explicitly passing dry_run=False (or CLI --live).
dry_run_default.rationale: Mistakes that cost nothing > mistakes that move USDC.

health_low_short_circuit.rule: If projected_ltv (cumulative_debt / cumulative_collateral) > safety_ltv after the next borrow → stop_reason='health_low'
health_low_short_circuit.rationale: Prevent the loop from walking off the edge of the liquidation cliff one iteration at a time.

sui_failure_halts.rule: Any sui_mcp call returning success=False halts the loop with stop_reason='error' (or 'lending_disabled' when the error contains 'SUI_LENDING_PACKAGE_ID not set').
sui_failure_halts.rationale: No partial-state on-chain loops. Stop, log, surface.

lending_disabled_clean_message.rule: If SUI_LENDING_PACKAGE_ID is absent (sui_mcp returns 'SUI_LENDING_PACKAGE_ID not set'), the loop halts on iteration 0 with stop_reason='lending_disabled' and the original sui_mcp error string stored in LoopStep[0].error.
lending_disabled_clean_message.rationale: Clean signal to the caller — 'lending is not configured', not 'something blew up'.

substrate: no per-loop on-disk state. Side effects = on-chain (via sui_mcp) + crystal chain entries (tier='defi_loop'). The LoopResult and all LoopSteps are returned in-memory; persistence is the caller's job.

inbound_callers: (planned) studio_runtime when a pass declares engine='defi_loop'
routing_connections.substrate_reads: SUI_LENDING_PACKAGE_ID presence (indirectly, via the sui_mcp error surface — defi_loop itself never reads .env)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: crystal chain entries only (no local sqlite, no JSONL)

guarantees: Stdlib-only — subprocess + json + hashlib (blake3 optional via inference_logger; falls back to blake2b)
DRY-RUN by default — caller must opt in to on-chain side effects
Soft-capped — target_leverage > 2.0 + live requires confirm_above_2x=True (rejects otherwise)
Deterministic — same input → same LoopResult.crystal byte-for-byte
Crystal-anchored — every deposit, every borrow, and the loop-complete summary are logged via inference_logger (tier='defi_loop')
Halt-on-failure — any sui_mcp failure halts the loop with stop_reason='error' (or 'lending_disabled' for the missing-package case)
Health-aware — projected debt/collateral above safety_ltv → stop_reason='health_low' before the borrow is sent
Composes only — never reaches around sui_mcp; never touches .env, cc.sh, or other connector modules
usage_example:
from core.lib.defi_loop import run_loop, USDC_MICRO_PER_UNIT
# DRY-RUN at 2x (safe default)
result = run_loop(pool_id='0xPOOL', base_collateral_micro=100 * USDC_MICRO_PER_UNIT, target_leverage=2.0, max_iters=4)
print(result.stop_reason, result.achieved_leverage, result.crystal[:16])
# LIVE at 3x (requires confirm_above_2x)
result = run_loop(pool_id='0xPOOL', base_collateral_micro=100_000_000, target_leverage=3.0, dry_run=False, confirm_above_2x=True)
